description: Access rights are not provisioned, reviewed, modified, and removed in accordance with policy.
applicability: Applies when an organization lacks processes for managing access rights throughout their lifecycle, including initial granting based on authorization, periodic reviews, modification upon role changes, and timely removal when no longer needed.

metadata.detection_notes: Review access provisioning procedures, assess access review schedules and completion, verify access removal upon termination or role change, check for excessive permissions, evaluate privileged access management, assess access certification processes.
